title: Ethiopia Is Building Africa's Biggest Airport for $12.5 Billion
description:
Ethiopia has started building Bishoftu International Airport, a $12.5 billion hub planned for 110 million passengers a year, more than London Heathrow or Dubai handled in 2025. It is due to open in 2030 with four runways and parking for 270 planes.

Subscribe for a new megaproject every day.

Sources:
Khaleej Times (Jan 2026): https://www.khaleejtimes.com/world/africa/ethiopia-construction-begins-bishoftu-international-airport

Ethiopian Airlines: https://corporate.ethiopianairlines.com/ground-service/home/ethiopian-airlines-marks-the-groundbreaking-of-bishoftu-international-airport-construction

scenes.headline: for Africa's biggest airport
scenes.say: Ethiopia is building a $12.5 billion airport. It will be the biggest in Africa.

scenes.question: Passengers a year
scenes.say: The airport in Addis Ababa today has room for 25 million passengers a year. London Heathrow handled 84.5 million last year. Dubai, the world's busiest international airport, handled 95.2 million. The new one is built for 110 million.

scenes.name: Bishoftu Airport
scenes.say: It will have 4 runways and parking for 270 planes. Construction started in January, about 45 km from the capital.
If it opens on time in 2030, Africa will have its biggest airport ever. Subscribe for more megaprojects.
